label.purpose: Field name and row captions, uppercase, tracked.

numeric.purpose: The price input and every computed monetary value, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: hard-offset
shadows.purpose: The card's only depth cue — a flat, zero-blur stamped block, never an ambient glow.

components.name: Card
components.description: The bordered black console holding the whole calculator.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #000000; color: #ffffff; border: 3px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #ff2400; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: The product price field — large tabular numerals, hard white border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; padding: 12px 14px 12px 34px; border-radius: 0; border: 2px solid #ffffff; background: #000000; color: #ffffff; outline: none; caret-color: #ff2400; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #999999; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #ff2400; outline: 2px solid #ff2400; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Total Block
components.description: The Net Commission row — the page's one inverted, filled surface, in Alarm Red.
components.css: .ds-total { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #ff2400; border: 2px solid #000000; padding: 14px 16px; } .ds-total-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #000000; } .ds-total-val { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900; color: #000000; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Everything here reads like a stripped instrument panel: black field, hard white rules, stenciled uppercase labels, and exactly one alarm color reserved for the number that matters. There is no ornament, no soft glow, no rounded comfort — the interface is a printed readout, not a friendly app. Weight does the talking: nothing on screen is drawn lighter than 700, so even the smallest label reads as a command, not a caption.
keyCharacteristics: Void-black field with hard white 2-3px rules standing in for all depth and separation
Exactly one saturated color (Alarm Red), spent only on the final total
All type at 700-900 weight; uppercase, tracked labels; tabular numerals throughout
Zero border-radius everywhere — every shape is a hard rectangle
A single flat, zero-blur offset shadow as the only depth cue on the page

rules.name: The One Alarm Rule
rules.body: Red appears in exactly one place: the final commission total. Everywhere else is black, white, or gray, so when red shows up it means "this is the number that matters."

rules.name: The No Regular Weight Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this screen is drawn below font-weight 700 — thin or regular type has no place in a brutalist instrument panel.

rules.name: The Flat Stamp Rule
rules.body: Depth is drawn as a hard offset block, never a blurred glow. Anything ambient is a foreign material in this system.

dos: Do keep red confined to the Net Commission block — the One Alarm Rule.
Do keep every border and rule hard-edged (0px radius) and at least 2px thick.
Do keep text weight at 700+ everywhere; no thin or regular type.
donts: Don't add soft, blurred, or ambient shadows — only the flat offset block earns a shadow here.
Don't load an external webfont; the app must render and cache fully offline.
Don't treat the current commission rates (10% / 15% / 3%) as final — they're explicit placeholders per PRODUCT.md.
